title: personal.json sidebar
description: The personal sidebar of the person (table user_space_states, docs/spec/20-privacy.md section 5.2): per space the collapsed state, the personal order and the personal order of its channels, archived spaces included. Only the space ID, never the space name.

space_id.description: ID of the space the row belongs to.

collapsed.description: Whether the person collapsed the space in the sidebar.

sort_key.description: The personal sort key of the space; absent when the person follows the global order.

channel_order.description: The personal order of the channels and forums of the space, as channel IDs; absent when the person follows the default order.

updated_by_device_id.description: ID of the device of the last change; absent when unknown or the device is gone.

updated_at.description: When the row was last changed.
